cases.title: Anonymous visitor is sent to the sign-in page
steps: Open the site without signing in.
cases.expected: Both requests land on the sign-in page; no school data is shown.
cases.actual: Redirected to /Account/Login with ReturnUrl preserved.

cases.title: Sign in with username and password
cases.expected: The dashboard opens and the header shows the signed-in user and a Sign out button.
cases.actual: Signed in; dashboard shows "" and header chip "folake.adeyemi".

cases.title: Sign in with email address
cases.expected: Sign-in succeeds with the email address as well as the username.
cases.actual: Signed in with the email address.

cases.title: Wrong password is rejected without revealing which field was wrong
cases.expected: User stays on the sign-in page with a generic "invalid" error message.
cases.actual: Stayed on sign-in page; message: "Invalid sign in attempt."

cases.title: Sign out ends the session
steps: Press Sign out in the header.
Press the browser Back button / open / again.
cases.expected: User is returned to the sign-in page and cannot reach the dashboard without signing in again.
cases.actual: Signed out; revisiting / goes back to the sign-in page.

cases.title: SuperAdmin dashboard shows user statistics and shortcuts
cases.expected: Welcome banner, "Manage users" and "Add user" shortcuts, and counts of users, roles, active and deactivated accounts, each with its icon; header shows the user chip and Sign out icons.
cases.actual: 6 dashboard/header icons render as empty boxes (icon name missing)

cases.title: Parent dashboard greets the parent and shows nothing about other users
cases.expected: A personal welcome (by name) and portal-relevant content. School-wide account statistics (total users, deactivated accounts, roles) are not shown to families.
cases.actual: Parent sees school-wide account statistics: Staff & students 58 | Roles configured 7 | Active users 58 | Deactivated 0

cases.title: Menu and page access for the SuperAdmin role
steps: Open every link in the sidebar.
cases.expected: Sidebar shows exactly: User Management, Administration, Academics, Family, Attendance, Results & Reports, Finance, Store & Inventory, Communications. Every sidebar link opens (none ends in "Access denied"). Permitted pages open; restricted pages show "Access denied".
cases.actual: Menu shows User Management, Administration, Academics, Family, Attendance, Results & Reports, Finance, Store & Inventory, Communications; all 39 menu links open; 11 permitted pages open; 2 restricted pages are refused with "Access denied".

cases.title: Menu and page access for the HeadTeacher role
steps: Open every link in the sidebar.
cases.expected: Sidebar shows exactly: Administration, Academics, Family, Attendance, Results & Reports, Finance, Store & Inventory, Communications. Every sidebar link opens (none ends in "Access denied"). Permitted pages open; restricted pages show "Access denied".
cases.actual: Menu shows Administration, Academics, Family, Attendance, Results & Reports, Finance, Store & Inventory, Communications; all 36 menu links open; 12 permitted pages open; 3 restricted pages are refused with "Access denied".

cases.title: Menu and page access for the Teacher role
steps: Open every link in the sidebar.
cases.expected: Sidebar shows exactly: Academics, Attendance, Results & Reports. Every sidebar link opens (none ends in "Access denied"). Permitted pages open; restricted pages show "Access denied".
cases.actual: Menu links that end in "Access denied": /sessions, /terms, /classes, /subjects, /timetable-periods, /results, /reports

cases.title: Menu and page access for the SchoolBursar role
steps: Open every link in the sidebar.
cases.expected: Sidebar shows exactly: Finance. Every sidebar link opens (none ends in "Access denied"). Permitted pages open; restricted pages show "Access denied".
cases.actual: Menu shows Finance; all 8 menu links open; 7 permitted pages open; 7 restricted pages are refused with "Access denied".

cases.title: Menu and page access for the SchoolStoreKeeper role
steps: Open every link in the sidebar.
cases.expected: Sidebar shows exactly: Store & Inventory. Every sidebar link opens (none ends in "Access denied"). Permitted pages open; restricted pages show "Access denied".
cases.actual: Menu shows Store & Inventory; all 7 menu links open; 6 permitted pages open; 6 restricted pages are refused with "Access denied".

cases.title: Menu and page access for the Parent role
steps: Open every link in the sidebar.
cases.expected: Sidebar shows exactly: Parent portal. Every sidebar link opens (none ends in "Access denied"). Permitted pages open; restricted pages show "Access denied".
cases.actual: Menu shows Parent portal; all 5 menu links open; 4 permitted pages open; 8 restricted pages are refused with "Access denied".

cases.title: Menu and page access for the Student role
steps: Open every link in the sidebar.
cases.expected: Sidebar shows exactly: Student portal. Every sidebar link opens (none ends in "Access denied"). Permitted pages open; restricted pages show "Access denied".
cases.actual: Menu shows Student portal; all 9 menu links open; 7 permitted pages open; 7 restricted pages are refused with "Access denied".

cases.title: Users list shows every account with roles and status
cases.expected: A paged grid lists users with name, username, role badges and Active/Inactive status, plus Edit / Assign roles / Deactivate actions.
cases.actual: No users listed

cases.title: Search and filter users by role and status
steps: Type "bakare" in Search and press Tab.
cases.expected: Search finds only Tunde Bakare; Role = Teacher lists the 4 teachers only; Inactive shows the empty message (nobody is deactivated yet).
cases.actual: Search → 1 row (Tunde Bakare); Role=Teacher → 4 teachers, all with the Teacher badge; + Status=Inactive → "No users match your filters."

cases.title: Create user requires at least one role
steps: Fill first name, last name, username, email and matching passwords.
Leave all roles unticked and press Create user.
cases.expected: The Roles box is highlighted with "Please assign at least one role" and no account is created.
cases.actual: Warning shown: "Please assign at least one role"

cases.title: Create a new teacher account
steps: On Add New User, enter Title Mrs., Kemi Adewale, gender Female, phone, username, email, password "Teach@2026" twice.
Sign in as the new user in another browser.
cases.expected: "User created" confirmation; the user appears in All Users with the Teacher badge and can sign in with the new password.
cases.actual: "User created Kemi Adewale is ready to go."; listed as "Kemi Adewale kemi.adewalei5fgb@naijaprimeschool.ng kemi.adewalei5fgb TEACHER ACTIVE edit admin_panel_settings block"; new user signed in successfully.

cases.title: Duplicate username is rejected
steps: Enter username "chinedu.okeke" (already taken), other valid details and a role.
cases.expected: An error explains the username is already taken; no second account is created.
cases.actual: Rejected: "Could not create user Username 'chinedu.okeke' is already taken."

cases.title: Edit a user's profile
steps: In All Users, press Edit on Kemi Adewale.
Change Phone to 08030001122 and Middle name to "Oluwakemi".
cases.expected: "User updated" confirmation; the changes are shown when the page is reopened.
cases.actual: "User updated Kemi Adewale."; phone persisted as 08030001122.

cases.title: Reset a user's password
steps: On Kemi Adewale's edit page press Reset password.
Enter "NewPass@2026" in both boxes and press Update password.
Sign in as the user with the old and then the new password.
cases.expected: A too-short password is refused in the dialog; the valid one shows "Password updated."; the old password no longer works and the new one does.
cases.actual: Short password refused ("Password must be at least 8 characters."); "Done Password updated."; old password refused, new password accepted.

cases.title: Assign an additional role to a user
steps: In All Users press Assign roles on Kemi Adewale.
Tick SchoolBursar as well as Teacher.
cases.expected: "Roles updated" confirmation; All Users shows both Teacher and SchoolBursar badges; the user now sees the Finance menu.
cases.actual: "Roles updated Role assignments saved."; badges: Kemi Oluwakemi Adewale kemi.adewalei5fgb@naijaprimeschool.ng kemi.adewalei5fgb TEACHERSCHOOLBURSAR ACTIVE edit admin_panel_settings block; user now sees the Finance menu.

cases.title: Deactivated user cannot sign in until reactivated
steps: In All Users press Deactivate on Kemi Adewale and confirm.
Try to sign in as her.
cases.expected: After deactivation the row shows Inactive and sign-in is refused; after activation she can sign in again.
cases.actual: Deactivated → sign-in refused ("deactivated"); activated → sign-in works.

cases.title: Roles page lists the seven system roles
cases.expected: SuperAdmin, HeadTeacher, Teacher, SchoolBursar, SchoolStoreKeeper, Parent and Student are listed with descriptions, each marked System.
cases.actual: 7 roles listed: SuperAdmin, HeadTeacher, Teacher, SchoolBursar, SchoolStoreKeeper, Parent, Student.

cases.title: Sessions list shows the current session with its terms and classes
steps: Sign in as the head teacher.
cases.expected: 2025/2026 and 2026/2027 are listed; 2026/2027 carries the "Current" badge with 3 terms and 7 classes.
cases.actual: Current session row: "2026/2027CURRENT 1 Sep 2026 31 Jul 2027 3 7 edit delete"

cases.title: Session dates are validated
steps: Name "2027/2028", start 1 Sep 2028, end 31 Jul 2027 (before the start).
cases.expected: "End date must be after start date." and nothing is saved.
cases.actual: Refused: "Failed End date must be after start date."

cases.title: Create next year's session
steps: Name "2027/2028", start 1 Sep 2027, end 31 Jul 2028; leave "Mark current" off.
cases.expected: "Session '2027/2028' saved." and it appears in the list without the Current badge; 2026/2027 stays current.
cases.actual: "Saved Session '2027/2028' saved."; 2027/2028 listed, 2026/2027 still current.

cases.title: Duplicate session name is rejected
steps: Enter name "2026/2027" (already exists) with valid dates.
cases.expected: "A session named '2026/2027' already exists."
cases.actual: Refused: "Failed A session named '2026/2027' already exists."

cases.title: Switch the current session and back
cases.expected: Only one session is ever marked Current; the switch is confirmed each time and the list updates immediately.
cases.actual: "Current session '2025/2026' is now the current session." then switched back; exactly one Current badge each time.

cases.title: Terms list and filter by session
cases.expected: First, Second and Third Term are listed with dates; the term containing today is marked Current.
cases.actual: 3 terms; current: "2026/2027 First TermCURRENT 8 Sep 2026 18 Dec 2026 edit delete"

cases.title: Add a term to next year's session
cases.expected: "Term saved." the first time; the repeat is refused with "That term already exists for this session."
cases.actual: Saved once; duplicate refused: "Failed That term already exists for this session."

cases.title: A session with terms cannot be deleted
steps: On Sessions press Delete on 2027/2028 and confirm.
On Terms delete 2027/2028 First Term and confirm.
cases.expected: First delete is refused ("Cannot delete a session that still has terms or classes attached."); after its term is removed the session deletes.
cases.actual: Refused: "Failed Cannot delete a session that still has terms or classes attached."; after removing the term: "Deleted Session '2027/2028' deleted."

cases.title: Create a class with a class teacher
steps: Open Academics → Classes and press New class.
Name "Primary 3B", level Primary 3, session 2026/2027, class teacher Grace Udoh.
cases.expected: "Class 'Primary 3B' saved." and the grid shows its level, session and class teacher.
cases.actual: "Saved Class 'Primary 3B' saved."; row: Primary 3B Primary 3 2026/2027 Grace Udoh edit delete

cases.title: Class names are unique within a session; classes on a timetable cannot be deleted
steps: Press New class; name "Primary 5A", level Primary 5, current session; Save.
Press Delete on Primary 5A and confirm.
cases.expected: Duplicate refused ("A class named 'Primary 5A' already exists in this session."); delete refused ("Cannot delete a class that has timetable entries.").
cases.actual: Duplicate: "Failed A class named 'Primary 5A' already exists in this session."; delete: "Failed Cannot delete a class that has timetable entries."

cases.title: Create, validate and delete a subject
steps: Open Academics → Subjects; press New subject.
Press Delete on Mathematics and confirm.
Press Delete on French and confirm.
cases.expected: Code clash refused; French saved; Mathematics cannot be deleted because it is on a timetable; French is deleted.
cases.actual: Clash: "Failed Subject code 'MTH' is already in use."; in use: "Failed Cannot delete a subject that is on a timetable."; French created then deleted.

cases.title: Timetable periods: list, add, validate, delete
cases.expected: Seven teaching periods plus Short Break and Lunch are listed; an end time before the start is refused; "Clubs" is saved and then deleted.
cases.actual: 9 periods listed; bad times refused ("Failed End time must be after start time."); Clubs added and deleted.

cases.title: View a class timetable
steps: Choose the current First Term and class Primary 5A.
cases.expected: A Monday–Friday grid with every period; all 35 teaching slots show subject code, name and teacher; break rows are shaded.
cases.actual: 35 lessons across Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday.

cases.title: Assign a lesson by clicking an empty cell
steps: Subject English Language, teacher Grace Udoh, room "Block A, Room 3"; Save.
cases.expected: "Timetable updated." and the cell shows ENG / English Language / the teacher.
cases.actual: "Saved Timetable updated."; cell shows "ENG English Language Grace Udoh"

cases.title: A teacher cannot be double-booked in the same period
cases.preconditions: Seed data: Mr. Chinedu Okeke teaches Primary 5A Mathematics on Monday, Period 2.
steps: Subject Mathematics, teacher Chinedu Okeke; Save.
cases.expected: The lesson is refused with a clear message that Mr. Okeke is already teaching Primary 5A at that time.
cases.actual: The clash was accepted: Mr. Okeke is now timetabled in Primary 5A and Primary 4A on Monday, Period 2.

cases.title: Teacher can view the class timetable
steps: Open Academics → Timetable; choose First Term and Primary 5A.
cases.expected: The full Primary 5A week is shown.
cases.actual: Teacher sees all 35 lessons.

cases.title: Students list shows pupils as soon as it opens
steps: Sign in as the head teacher.
cases.expected: All 30 pupils are listed (paged) with photo/initials, admission number, class, primary contact and status.
cases.actual: The grid is empty ("No students match your filters.") until a filter is changed

cases.title: Search and filter pupils
cases.expected: Search finds Chiamaka and Tobenna Okafor; the class filter lists the 13 Primary 5A pupils.
cases.actual: Okafor → Chiamaka and Tobenna; Primary 5A → 13 pupils.

cases.title: Admission rules are enforced
steps: Enter admission number "NPS/26/001" (already used), date of birth after the admission date, and the other required fields.
Press Save student; then fix the date of birth and save again.
cases.expected: Date of birth after admission is refused; then the duplicate admission number is refused. No pupil is created.
cases.actual: "Date of birth must be earlier than the admission date." then "A student with admission number 'NPS/26/001' already exists."

cases.title: Admit a new pupil with a class and a portal login
steps: Admission number NPS/UAT/I5FGB, admission date today, Adaeze NnajiI5FGB, female, born 3 Mar 2018, blood group O+, state Enugu, allergy "Penicillin".
Portal sign-in: username adaeze.nnajii5fgb, password Family@123.
Sign in as the new pupil.
cases.expected: The pupil's page opens; Enrolment history shows Primary 3A (Active); the pupil can sign in to the Student portal straight away.
cases.actual: Opened "Adaeze NnajiI5FGB"; enrolled in Primary 3A (Active); pupil signed in to the portal.

cases.title: Update a pupil's medical notes
steps: Profile tab: Medical notes "Asthmatic – inhaler kept in the sick bay"; Save changes.
cases.expected: "Student profile updated." and the note is still there after reloading.
cases.actual: "Saved Student profile updated."; persisted.

cases.title: Upload a pupil photograph
steps: On the pupil's page open the Photo tab.
Choose new photo → select a JPEG under 2 MB.
Open Students and search for the pupil.
cases.expected: "Uploaded" confirmation; the photo replaces the initials tile on the pupil page and in the Students list.
cases.actual: "Uploaded Pupil photograph updated."; photo shown in the Students list.

cases.title: Parents list shows parents as soon as it opens; search by phone
cases.expected: All 20 parents are listed on opening with contact details and pupil count; the phone search finds Ngozi Okafor with 2 pupils.
cases.actual: The grid is empty ("No parents match your filters.") until a filter is changed

cases.title: Register a parent with a portal login
steps: Mr. Obioma NnajiI5FGB, male, married, phone 08061234567, email, occupation "Accountant".
Portal sign-in: username obioma.nnajii5fgb, password Family@123.
cases.expected: The parent's page opens; the parent can sign in and sees the Parent portal with no wards yet.
cases.actual: Opened "Mr. Obioma NnajiI5FGB"; parent signed in; portal: "My wards campaign Announcements forum Messages notifications Reminder settings Parent po"

cases.title: Link a parent to a pupil as primary contact
steps: Open Adaeze's page → Parents tab → Link a parent.
Parent Obioma NnajiI5FGB, relationship Father, Primary contact on, Authorised to collect on.
Sign in as the parent and open My wards.
cases.expected: "Parent link saved."; the tab reads Parents (1) with a Primary badge; the parent now sees the pupil under My wards.
cases.actual: "Saved Parent link saved."; PARENTS (1); parent now sees Adaeze under My wards.

cases.title: Mark a guardian as not authorised to collect the pupil
steps: On the pupil's Parents tab press Edit link on the father.
Turn "Authorised to collect" off; add note "Collection by mother only (court order)"; Save link.
cases.expected: A "Cannot pick up" badge appears next to the parent with the note.
cases.actual: Row now reads "Obioma NnajiI5FGBPRIMARYCANNOT PICK UP 08061234567 · obioma.nnajii5fgb@example.ng Father Collection by mother only (court order) edit link_off"

cases.title: Update a parent's contact details
steps: Change Alternate phone to 07012345678 and Employer to "Access Bank"; Save changes.
cases.expected: "Parent profile updated."; the Pupils tab lists the linked pupil.
cases.actual: "Saved Parent profile updated."; tabs: PROFILE | LINKED PUPILS (1) | REMINDERS

cases.title: Enrolments register: filter and withdraw
steps: Press Withdraw on Adaeze NnajiI5FGB and confirm.
cases.expected: Primary 3A shows its pupils; after withdrawal the row shows status Withdrawn with today's date.
cases.actual: 2 Primary 3A enrolments; "Withdrawn Enrolment withdrawn."; row: Adaeze NnajiI5FGB NPS/UAT/I5FGB Primary 3A 2026/2027 30 Sep 2026 30 Sep 2026 WITHDRAWN open_in_new delete

cases.title: Re-enrol a pupil in another class
steps: Open Adaeze's page → Enrolment history → New enrolment.
Class Primary 4A, enrolment date today; press Enrol.
Try to enrol again in Primary 2A.
cases.expected: The Primary 4A enrolment is Active; a second active enrolment in the same session is refused.
cases.actual: "Enrolled Pupil enrolled in class."; second enrolment refused: "Failed Student already has an active enrolment in this session. Withdraw it first."

cases.title: A deactivated parent can no longer sign in to the portal
steps: Open Obioma NnajiI5FGB's page and press Deactivate.
Try to sign in as the parent.
cases.expected: The parent shows Inactive and the portal login is refused while inactive; after Activate the parent can sign in again.
cases.actual: The deactivated parent could still sign in to the portal (only the parent record was deactivated, not the login).

cases.title: Deleting a parent: blocked while linked, then retires the login
steps: In Parents press Delete on Obioma NnajiI5FGB and confirm.
Unlink the parent from Adaeze's Parents tab.
Delete the parent again (same screen session).
Try to sign in as the parent.
cases.expected: First delete is refused (active link); after unlinking, the delete succeeds and the parent's portal login stops working.
cases.actual: Refused: "Failed Cannot delete this parent because 1 active student link(s) remain. Unlink them first."; after unlinking: "Deleted 'Obioma NnajiI5FGB' removed."; login retired.

cases.title: Open today's class register
cases.expected: "Register opened."; all 13 enrolled pupils are pre-loaded as Present (Present: 13, Total: 13), with the term and session shown.
cases.actual: Register opened; PRESENT: 13 ABSENT: 0 LATE: 0 TOTAL: 13

cases.title: Mark absences and late arrivals, then save
steps: On today's Primary 5A register set Kamsi Eze = Absent with remark "No word from parent".
cases.expected: "Attendance saved."; counts become Present 12 (late arrivals count as present), Absent 1, Late 1; the arrival time and remark are kept.
cases.actual: "Saved Attendance saved."; PRESENT: 12 ABSENT: 1 LATE: 1 TOTAL: 13; arrival 08:25 kept.

cases.title: Submit the register; it locks
steps: On today's Primary 5A register press Submit register.
cases.expected: "Register submitted."; a "Submitted <date time>" badge and a Reopen button replace Save/Submit; the status drop-downs are disabled.
cases.actual: PRESENT: 12 ABSENT: 1 LATE: 1 TOTAL: 13 SUBMITTED 30 SEP 02:53; 13 drop-downs disabled.

cases.title: Head teacher reopens a submitted register
steps: Sign in as the head teacher; open today's Primary 5A register.
Kamsi Eze's mother phones in: change him to Present; Submit register again.
cases.expected: "Register reopened for editing."; after the change and re-submission the counts show Present 13, Absent 0.
cases.actual: "Reopened Register reopened for editing."; after correction: PRESENT: 13 ABSENT: 0 LATE: 1 TOTAL: 13 SUBMITTED 30 SEP 02:53

cases.title: View an earlier day's submitted register
steps: Open the Primary 5A register for 29 Sep 2026.
cases.expected: The submitted register shows each pupil's recorded status (read-only) with counts.
cases.actual: PRESENT: 12 ABSENT: 1 LATE: 1 TOTAL: 13 SUBMITTED 30 SEP 02:44

cases.title: A register cannot be opened for a future date
steps: Choose Primary 5A and a date one week ahead.
cases.expected: The register is refused with a message that attendance cannot be taken in advance.
cases.actual: A register was opened for 7 Oct 2026, a week in the future.

cases.title: Take attendance for a timetabled lesson
steps: Term First Term, class Primary 5A, date today.
Press Take attendance on the first lesson.
Mark Zainab Bello Absent; press Submit.
cases.expected: Today's 7 lessons are listed from the timetable; the lesson register opens pre-filled; after Submit it shows Present 12, Absent 1 and "Submitted".
cases.actual: 7 lessons listed; after submit: PRESENT: 12 ABSENT: 1 TOTAL: 13 SUBMITTED 30 SEP 02:54
